'''Balthaz''' is a nobleman of [[Tanchico]].
== History ==
Balthaz is the owner of the [[Crescent Palace]], a very large and ornate residence. When he is absent from the city to visit his country estates in the west, he lets his estate to [[Belyne]] Sedai and two of her companions.<ref name="RPG">''[[The Wheel of Time Roleplaying Game]]''</ref>
